decision.summary: No new action: the daily 79k reach remains the correct live trade, and there is still no justified management trigger or replacement setup.
decision.rationale: Binance remains bullish short term with price holding near the highs and open interest still expanding, so the existing 79k reach daily remains the right live expression of the rebound thesis. The position is only slightly below breakeven and is not near take-profit or exceptional invalidation. Re-adding is not allowed because it already uses the full early-stage $1 live cash cap. The next bullish daily at 80k is now too weak around 4.5%, while bearish dailies and weekly dips remain completely out of sync with current execution reality. With only about 6 hours left until daily expiry, the disciplined move is to hold the current daily and avoid forcing a low-quality switch.
